method: Fresh read-only independent supplement over the 74 frozen tests/runtime paths. Read AGENTS.md and honored the human override of TWO complete clean rounds; did not execute any full suite. Before substantive review, the pinned Node v24.22.1 executable recomputed raw SHA-256 for every one of the 1901 frozen paths and called the exported scripts/snapshot.mjs snapshot() function; both matched. Read every assigned test, fixture, helper, JSON catalog and README body, including all assertion logic and platform/skip guards. Large service, workflow and realtime files were read in consecutive bounded ranges; truncated tool output was re-read for the omitted defaults-lifecycle and README content. Reviewed fixture setup/teardown ordering, isolated environment allowlists, local Responses/MCP substitutes and their request/output bounds, actual versus substituted native assertions, owner/client/channel/epoch isolation, final-write revocation, positive and negative permissions, prompt and request identity, unknown delivery/no-replay behavior, receipt projection and recovery proofs, history/queue/goal/session races, media capability freshness, file and witness durability limits, process-tree/controller cleanup acknowledgement, and retained-resource expiration. Cross-checked current native-environment helper, launch command, permission schema/comparator, limits, worker server, selected RuntimeService lifecycle boundaries, witness implementation and current test prerequisite runner. The native-version concern was resolved by the current runner prerequisite that checks official package metadata and version before native tests. No historical checkout, Git history, prior audit report/finding, personal CODEX_HOME or credentials were read. No source files were edited. Completeness here means body-and-assertion inspection of all 74 assigned paths, not AST/hash-only coverage or successful execution of these tests. At completion, recomputed all 1901 raw SHA-256 hashes again and invoked the exported canonical snapshot() again, with no mismatch.
limitations: Static audit only: no native CLI, test suite, type/build check, remote service, commercial inference, live account login, external MCP/OAuth or deployment operation was executed in this supplement. Only the pinned Node inventory verification/sealing script and read-only source commands were executed.
Platform-sensitive Windows Job/PTY and Linux cross-UID, systemd, filesystem fsync and physical crash behavior were reviewed in source and assertions, not re-established by live execution.
README statements about earlier integration results were treated only as source documentation to assess claim boundaries; referenced previous audit/evidence reports were not opened or used.
Production files were cross-references for relevant contracts; this supplement does not claim a separate complete production implementation audit.
